history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration review all cases of refunds that are pending from the implementing partners and take necessary action as stipulated in the operational handbook.
history.administration_response: A long-term agreement for the audit services has resulted in significant progress being made in clearing the backlog of audits in the different funds. The refund module of the grant management system was tracking the refunds from implementing partners and showed all outstanding refunds before or after the audit. This refund module also provides an email alert notifying the implementing partner to process the refund.
history.board_assessment: The Board notes that a significant number of refunds remains pending, as observed in the current audit. Therefore, the recommendation is considered to be under implementation.

history.board_assessment: Given that similar issues have been noted in audits in recent years and the Board reiterated this recommendation in the present audit, the Board considers this recommendation as having been overtaken by events.
